title: Where Does Your Fat Go When You Lose Weight?
question: Wait, where does it go? It can't just disappear.
promise: You will know the real exit door fat uses to leave your body.
answer: Most of the fat you lose leaves through your mouth, breathed out as an invisible gas, and the rest leaves as water.

thumbnail.subject: A person breathing out a big, bright, visible cloud, close up, the cloud filling half the frame

firstTenSeconds: Bare feet on a bathroom scale, the number drops by one kilo and a little yellow blob of fat lifts off and vanishes, as the narrator asks where that fat actually goes; then the camera pulls back to a crowd of experts, most of them marked wrong.
whyClick: Everyone has tried to lose weight or knows someone who has, and almost nobody can answer where the fat physically goes.
